remarks: An exceptional opportunity to own a prime oceanfront corner property in Newport Beach, featuring an impressive 40 feet of ocean frontage. Ideally positioned directly on the sand, this desirable corner location showcases breathtaking panoramic ocean views and an incredible setting to experience the best of coastal living. The residence features four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and approximately 2,839 square feet of living space. Enjoy spectacular sunsets, the sound of crashing waves, and sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean from this exceptional beachfront setting.
